wizard.title: New Project
wizard.description: Create a new spec project: choose where the .md files are kept and which NotebookLM notebook to sync with.

info.name: Project name
info.nameHint: Shown on the Projects screen and in the Workspace switcher. Must be different from other projects.
info.descriptionPlaceholder: Specs for an AI-assisted .md editor synced to NotebookLM

storage.pathHint: Full path. It must be writable and not used by another project.
storage.specsDirHint: Leave empty to keep spec files directly in the working folder.

gitToggle.label: Sync via Git
gitToggle.hint: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea or a Git URL.

driveToggle.label: Sync via Google Drive
driveToggle.hint: A Drive folder plus a copy on this machine.

gitDetected.title: This folder is already a Git repo
gitDetected.author: Commit author: {author}

localToggle.label: Store on this machine (Local) · required
localToggle.hint: The working folder above is the main copy where specs are edited. Turn on Git or Drive to sync elsewhere.

git.hostHintDefault: Leave empty to use {host}. Fill in only for a self-hosted server.
git.hostHint: Address of your Git server (for example git.company.vn).
git.connectViaHint: Manage connections in Settings › Integrations. Priority order: CLI, MCP, Token, SSH.
git.sshDescription: Uses the SSH keys already on this machine. It can only clone, pull and push. It can't list repos or create PRs.
git.needsLogin: This connection needs to sign in again. Run the login command in a terminal, then click Check in Settings › Integrations.
git.repoHint: Listed from {source}. If you don't see it, type owner/repo.
git.subdirHint: Leave empty to use the repo root.
git.publishMode: How changes are pushed after approval
git.pushDescription: Straight to the chosen branch. Quick, good for personal repos.
git.prDescription: Creates a branch from the template and opens a PR/MR. Approvals in the same session share one branch.
git.prDisabled: Needs a CLI, MCP or Token connection for this provider.
git.authorHint: Saved as the committer name and email in the repo. Leave empty to use this machine's general Git settings.
git.tokenUrlHint: Paste a Git URL that includes the token (https://user:TOKEN@host/owner/repo.git). The token is taken out and stored encrypted, and only the clean URL is kept in the settings.

autoPush.label: Push or open a PR automatically after committing
autoPush.hint: If off, click Push in the top bar when you're ready.

pullOnOpen.label: Pull when opening the Workspace
pullOnOpen.hint: Gets the latest changes from the remote every time you open it.

git.tokenDescription: Use a Personal Access Token to clone, pull and push (and create PRs if the token allows).
git.tokenHint: Needs read/write access to the repo (GitHub: contents read/write; GitLab: read_repository and write_repository). The token is stored encrypted, sent only to this server, and never written into the URL or .git/config.
git.tokenCheckFailed: The token was saved but the check didn't pass

google.connected: Signed in to Google and Drive access granted.
google.notConfigured: Google sign-in isn't set up on the server. Please contact your administrator.

drive.folderHint: Paste the Drive folder URL or ID. The ID is picked out automatically.
drive.authHint: Shared with NotebookLM sync through Drive if it is the same account.

pullOnOpen.label: Download when opening
pullOnOpen.hint: Gets the latest files from Drive every time you open the Workspace.

pushOnApprove.label: Upload after approving
pushOnApprove.hint: Saves the approved file to Drive.

notebook.notebookIdHint: Paste the notebook URL or ID. The ID is picked out automatically.

DRIVE_SYNC.title: Through Google Drive
DRIVE_SYNC.description: Writes specs as Google Docs, then refreshes the source. Reliable, recommended.

RPC.title: Direct with cookie
RPC.description: Deletes the old source and uploads the new one. Fast, but fails when the cookie expires.

notebook.driveFolderHint: The Drive folder that holds the Google Doc copies of the specs.
notebook.rpcHint: Connect NotebookLM in Settings › Integrations (paste the cookie) before syncing.
notebook.mapping: Each spec file matches one source with the same name in the notebook.

autoSyncOnApprove.label: Sync to NotebookLM automatically after approving a change

notebook.checkLater: The notebook connection is checked right after the project is created.

import.title: Import specs from NotebookLM
import.hint: For a folder stored only on this machine, you can use the notebook's text sources as the first spec files (file names follow the source titles). Files already in the folder are never overwritten. This happens once when the project is created, not each time it is opened.
import.needNotebook: Enter a Notebook ID above to see its sources.
import.empty: This notebook has no sources yet.
import.errorHint: Check the NotebookLM connection in Settings › Integrations.
import.notImportable: PDF, web page, YouTube and Google Doc sources only have extracted text and lose their formatting, so they can't be imported as specs.
import.remoteFirst: Git or Drive is on, so the first specs come from there and not from NotebookLM (priority: Git, Drive, NotebookLM).

review.name: Name
review.publishPr: Create a branch and a Pull/Merge Request
review.hint: Click Create Project to create the folder, download the repo or Drive folder, save the settings to .spec-studio/config.json and add the project to the list.

run.title: Progress

create.LOCAL: Create the folder and save settings
create.GIT: Download the repo and save settings
create.DRIVE: Download the Drive folder and save settings
create.NOTEBOOK_IMPORT: Create the folder, import specs from NotebookLM and save settings

run.checkDescription: Folder, Git remote, Drive access, notebook
